item.title: Love Or Harassment? The Haein Lee Figure Skating Scandal
item.description: South Korean figure skater Haein Lee was suspended for three years after the Korea Skating Union accused her of sexually harassing a junior male skater during a 2024 training camp. Lee said they had been in a relationship and denied the allegation. A Seoul court later suspended the disciplinary action, allowing her to compete again.

item.title: He Drove 105 MPH And Killed His Best Friend
item.description: In November 2023, 16-year-old Kiernan Tague was driving a BMW at 105 mph on a 25 mph residential street in Grosse Pointe Farms when he lost control and crashed, killing his 18-year-old friend Flynn MacKrell. Tague later pleaded guilty to manslaughter and received a blended sentence of juvenile placement, probation, and a suspended 19-to-38-month prison term.

item.title: The Billionaire Who Offered Millions For Someone To Marry His Daughter
item.description: Hong Kong property tycoon Cecil Chao made headlines after offering HK$500 million to any man who could win the heart of his lesbian daughter, Gigi, and marry her. He later doubled the offer to HK$1 billion, but Gigi publicly rejected the idea and asked her father to accept her relationship with her female partner.

item.title: How Did Everyone Miss The Signs At Fox Hollow Farm?
item.description: For years, Herbert Baumeister appeared to be a successful businessman and family man while men were disappearing across Indiana. Even after a human skull was discovered on his property and investigators began connecting him to missing men, they struggled to search the farm. In 1996, thousands of human bones were finally uncovered there, but Baumeister died by suicide before he could ever face trial.
